benefits.name: Admirals Club Membership
benefits.description: Complimentary Admirals Club membership, valued up to $1,400, with unlimited lounge visits for the cardmember plus up to 2 guests or immediate family.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Cardmember plus up to 2 guests or immediate family per visit.

benefits.name: Inflight & Admirals Club Purchase Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 in statement credits per calendar year on inflight purchases and eligible Admirals Club purchases.

benefits.name: AA Vacations Statement Credit
benefits.description: Up to $500 annual statement credit on eligible American Airlines Vacations packages, split into two $250 windows (January-June and July-December).
benefits.terms: Split into two $250 semiannual windows: January-June and July-December.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit up to $120 every 4 years for a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee.

benefits.name: Avis/Budget Prepaid Rental Credit
benefits.description: Up to $120 annual statement credit on eligible prepaid Avis or Budget car rentals booked directly through avis.com or budget.com.
benefits.terms: Rentals must be prepaid and booked directly through avis.com or budget.com.

benefits.name: Lyft Credit
benefits.description: $15 statement credit after 3 eligible Lyft rides in a calendar month, up to $180 annually.
benefits.terms: Requires 3 eligible Lyft rides per calendar month to earn the $15 credit; capped at $180 total per year.

benefits.name: Avis President's Club Status
benefits.description: Complimentary enrollment in Avis President's Club, Avis's top loyalty tier.
benefits.terms: Enrollment available through Aug. 31, 2028 per current terms; confirm this deadline is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First checked bag free on domestic American Airlines itineraries for the cardmember plus up to 8 companions on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Priority Check-in, Screening & Boarding
benefits.description: Priority check-in, airport screening, and priority boarding on American Airlines flights for the cardmember plus up to 8 companions.

benefits.name: Loyalty Points Milestone Bonus
benefits.description: Up to 40,000 additional AAdvantage Loyalty Points annually, earned as 10,000-point bonuses at four milestone thresholds during the qualification year.

earningRates.terms: Eligible bookings through AAdvantage Hotels and AAdvantage Cars.
Eligible American Airlines purchases. Increases to 5x after $150,000 in calendar-year spend, for the remainder of that year.
